alternatives.agreement_date: The cover page states an EFFECTIVE DATE of June 1, 1998; that is the Effective Date defined in Section 1.1, not the signature date, so agreement_date keeps the May 5, 1998 signature date.
alternatives.expiration_date: Section 4.0 and Attachment 1 Section 2.0 set a three-year initial term from the Effective Date but state no calendar end date; the December 31, 1998 date is the end of Transition Services, not the initial term.
alternatives.signatories: Reading only the base agreement execution block would list Kevin C. Melia and R. G. Richter; the exhibit also carries Amendments 001-010, Attachment 1, a Confidential Information Agreement and an Equipment and Program Loan Agreement, whose /s/ blocks add Roy B. Covington III, Dale R. Johnson, Nigel D. Davis and Craig A. Bloszinsky.
alternatives.party_roles: No supplier, customer, purchaser, vendor or contractor word is used for IBM or MSL, so both take other. A software attachment defines 'Customers' to include IBM, which could support customer for IBM; MSL manufactures and sells Products to IBM.
alternatives.contract_value: The only dollar figure is $25,000 in EPLA Section 15, a limitation of liability, not consideration; all price and consideration figures are redacted as [*].
alternatives.termination_notice_period: The Confidential Information Agreement (Section 8) allows either party to terminate on [*] month's written notice; the breach cure period in Section 5.1 is also redacted as [*] Days.
alternatives.territory: No exclusive territorial grant is stated. The Equipment and Program Loan Agreement separately restricts installation of Loaned Items to the United States or Puerto Rico.

supplementary.notes: Exhibit 10.14 bundles the IBM/MSL Outsourcing Base Agreement with Amendments 001-010, Attachment 1 (Statement of Work) and other attachments, a Confidential Information Agreement, and an Equipment and Program Loan Agreement. All consideration and cure-period figures are redacted under the confidential treatment request. Signatories lists every person whose /s/ appears in an execution block in the exhibit; blank signature lines were not counted. party_roles uses other because no registered role word is stated for either party.
